Author: Kotanna
Name: Flick Wheel
Punchline: Flick the right stick to switch jobs or open anything.
Description: Hold Ctrl+, to open a radial wheel, flick the right stick toward an entry, and let go to use it. Switch jobs from fixed, role-grouped positions you can learn by feel, or build a wheel of your own shortcuts: game windows, Teleport, items and plugin commands.
